verdicts.note: Rename the dimension of E (for example to d_E), since m on the dyadic page is an integer numerator.
Rename the tail vertex (for example to p), since x is the first bank value on the linear network page.
Rename the head vertex (for example to q), since y is the second bank value on the linear network page.
Rename the route length (for example to t), since s on the subspace and recursive pages is the total number of smaller calls.
Rename the edge rank (for example to rk(e)), since a is the real part of a Gaussian dyadic number on the dyadic page.
Rename the route length (for example to t), since s on the recursive-saving page is the total number of smaller calls.
Rename the field width (for example to w), since u is the first butterfly input on the dyadic page.
Rename the field width (for example to w), since u is the tail vertex on the frame page.
Rename the stored volume (for example to Q), since V on the role-streams page is the padded bit volume of a node, not a count of data units.
Rename the matrix size (for example to mu), since m is the space dimension on the subspace page.
Rename the matrix size (for example to mu), since m is the integer numerator on the dyadic page.
Rename the digit width (for example to beta), since b is the second coefficient list on the cyclic convolution page.
Rename the linear map on E (for example to A), since S is the list length on the cyclic convolution page.
Rename the layer (for example to B_D), since H0 on the tensor-product page is the two-point butterfly and the layer is its D-fold tensor power.
Rename the layer (for example to B_D), since H0 on the dyadic page is the two-point map and the layer applies it to d chunks at once.
Rename the second summation index (for example to t), since r is the power-of-two coefficient count on the roots-of-unity, polynomial-ring and butterfly-layer pages.
Rename the chunk length (for example to l), since e is a general vector of E on the tensor-product page.
Rename the second summation index (for example to t), since r is the reduced length on the roots-of-unity page.
Rename the second summation index (for example to t), since r is the coefficient count on the polynomial-ring page.
Rename the shift count (for example to h), since k is an output index on the Fourier and cyclic convolution pages.
Rename the shift count (for example to h), since k is the output index of c on the cyclic convolution page.
Rename the primitive root (for example to theta), since rho on the order-of-element page is a positive integer exponent.
Rename the normalized cyclic product (for example to psi), since zeta on the roots-of-unity page is a primitive q-th root of unity.
Rename the near-identity map (for example to M), since N on the Fourier transform page is an operation count.
Rename the twisted sequence (for example to sigma), since nu on the gaussian-resampling page is a power exponent.
Rename the coefficient index (for example to lambda), since k on the polynomial-ring page is a shift count.
Rename the axis digit (for example to delta_i), since a_i on the polynomial-ring page is the coefficient of y^i.
Rename the axis index (for example to alpha), since i on the polynomial-ring page is a coefficient position.
Rename the axis index (for example to alpha), since i on the cyclic convolution page is a list index.
Rename the second axis index (for example to beta_2), since j on the Fourier transform page is an entry index of u.
Rename the second axis index (for example to beta_2), since j on the cyclic convolution page is the second list index.
Rename the width factor (for example to phi), since m on the dyadic page is an integer numerator.
Rename the width factor (for example to phi), since m on the radix-digit page is a digit count.
Rename the width factor (for example to phi), since m on the tape-interchange page is a matrix size.
